question: Please identify the top three customers, based on their customer_unique_id, who have the highest number of delivered orders, and provide the average payment value, city, and state for each of these customers.
sql:
-- Verify the top customer's delivered orders
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state
    FROM olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        d.order_id,
        d.customer_unique_id,
        SUM(p.payment_value) as total_payment
    FROM delivered_orders d
    JOIN olist_order_payments p ON d.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY d.order_id, d.customer_unique_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        op.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT op.order_id) as delivered_order_count,
        AVG(op.total_payment) as avg_payment_value,
        ANY_VALUE(d.customer_city) as customer_city,
        ANY_VALUE(d.customer_state) as customer_state
    FROM order_payments op
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON op.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY op.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT customer_unique_id, delivered_order_count, ROUND(avg_payment_value, 2) as avg_payment_value, customer_city, customer_state
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC, customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 3
